Uma (Product): idea: add a small 'ad-hoc SLO override' flow in console for short migrations. must not create backend rule churn. thoughts?
Ethan (Eng): merge-on-eval overlay seems right. store overlays separately and apply at eval time with a cache.
Nikhil (Eng-Platform): agree. API sketch: POST /api/v1/overlays {overlay_id, base_slo, tenant, threshold, ttl_seconds, notify_scope, reason}
Maya (SRE): default notify_scope->cs-only. include tags so alerts show up in telemetry as overlay_applied=true. need dashboards for that metric
Uma (Product): preview button in UI to estimate delta would be helpful for CS. must be cheap and approximate
Ethan (Eng): implement preview by sampling N windows (1% sample) and returning counts + error bounds + approximate:true
Maya (SRE): add caps (max active overlays per-tenant = 4) and global backpressure. also auto-expire overlays and email CS on expiry
Nikhil (Eng-Platform): implementation notes: use small KV store with TTL, cache per (rule, tenant) 60s, merge at evaluation, emit overlay.id and overlay.origin tags on alerts
ci-bot: CI queued for branch `slo-overlay-mini` build 9876 — https://ci.redwood.local/builds/9876
Uma (Product): I'll write acceptance criteria and pilot plan (internal tenants first). next: Nikhil prototype + Ethan metrics hooks + Maya ops playbook
